info.title: Iris Mobile BFF API
info.description: API contract used by the ev-flutter mobile application. Paths under `/d2s` are accepted by the BFF and forwarded to network-service. Machine-to-machine webhooks, OCPP callbacks, cron operations, settlement, embed, and external-partner APIs are intentionally excluded.

ApiResponse.description: Common response envelope. Some legacy endpoints return `code` in the body while the HTTP response remains 200.
